title: OpenAI hosted creators at a luxe retreat. The internet isn't charmed.
excerpt: Over the weekend, influencers posted optimistic videos of AI after attending an OpenAI-led content creator retreat.
content_html:
OpenAI hosted influencers at a luxury retreat with beekeeping. The internet backlash was swift.

By Ben Shimkus

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Beneath a canopy of trees at a 140-acre resort, bistro lights illuminated a long wooden table set for about 30 people. There, content creators gathered for dinner of farm-to-table food and wine.

At one end of the table, a glowing OpenAI logo completed the scene.

Over the weekend, several influencers posted videos from what they called "OpenAI Summer Camp," held at Wildflower Farms, a luxury resort in New York's Hudson Valley. Weekend room rates typically exceed $2,000 a night.

According to attendees' posts, the itinerary included meals, lessons about OpenAI's latest tools, and outdoor activities, including a session with a beekeeper.

Creators also received OpenAI-branded merchandise, including canvas bags and jars of honey.

The idyllic retreat did not charm everyone online.

OpenAI told Business Insider the retreat was an education-focused event tied to the recent launch of ChatGPT Work and part of its broader effort to market practical uses for its products through creators.

"Creators are an important part of our community and how people get information and learn about our products today," a spokesperson said.

OpenAI's top-end getaway also comes as the AI labs attempt to turn around their public image. The firms — which have been quickly constructing data centers across the US — have faced backlash amid anxiety about rising energy prices, water use, and potential job displacement.

But this weekend's pastoral content quickly drew criticism on social media. Many questioned why a company associated with several energy- and water-intensive data centers was courting influencers at a nature-focused resort.

"This is the proper context to use the word dystopian," one Redditor wrote.

Across X, Reddit, TikTok, and Instagram, commenters accused OpenAI of "greenwashing," while others criticized creators for promoting AI without discussing concerns about the technology's environmental impact.

Journalist Taylor Lorenz wrote on X that creators attending the event were getting "cancelled."

Influencers are getting cancelled for going on the OpenAI brand summer camp weekend trip, which is very interesting bc I have not seen similar criticism towards influencers who have been attending Anthropic events (which also works with the Dept of War). Have I just missed it? pic.twitter.com/rWsJQf8CaG

— Taylor Lorenz (@TaylorLorenz) August 3, 2026

Startup Signull Labs, the creator of the AI agent service Skye, compared the retreat to OpenAI rival Anthropic's retreat. The startup wrote on its X account that Anthropic kept its retreats low-key, with subtle private dinners rather than "conspicuous luxury retreats."

"But OpenAI made the influence operation completely visible & that's probably what irked ppl," it wrote.

None of the creators at OpenAI's retreat contacted by Business Insider responded to requests for comment. OpenAI did not answer whether attendees on this particular trip were paid, whether OpenAI covered their travel or accommodations, or whether they were expected to post.

"We welcome healthy debate as AI becomes more prevalent, and we value creators who choose to engage with us, attend our events, ask tough questions, and learn alongside everyone else," a spokesperson said. "We'll continue to value them, just as we do traditional media and other marketing partners."

Grace McCarrick, one of the creators who attended, posted a video saying she wanted to make a series after "being in the room with people who work on this product." She recorded the video before a day of coding — and while preparing a bath.

"The irony of running a bath at a ChatGPT brand trip," one commenter said.

She's since posted two videos responding to negative comments.

"My morals were not compromised," she said in one video. "I am supremely excited about AI and the opportunities it offers to our species. Full stop."

OpenAI is not the first company to learn that an influencer getaway can generate scrutiny.

In 2023, fast-fashion giant Shein faced fierce criticism after flying creators to China for a curated tour of its facilities. Viewers accused the influencers of helping the company whitewash allegations about its labor and environmental practices. Cosmetics company Tarte has also repeatedly drawn backlash over lavish creator trips.

Aditi Bharade contributed reporting.

He's also held staff writing positions at The U.S. Sun and the Daily Mail. He graduated from NYU with a Master's in journalism in 2024. Email Ben at bshimkus@insider.com or message him privately on Signal at bshimkus.41.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 在一个养蜂的豪华度假胜地接待了有影响力的人士。 互联网上的强烈反对很快。

作者：Ben Shimkus 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

在占地 140 英亩的度假村的树冠下，小酒馆的灯光照亮了一张可容纳约 30 人的长木桌。 在那里，内容创作者聚集在一起享用从农场到餐桌的美食和美酒晚餐。

在桌子的一端，一个发光的 OpenAI 标志完成了这一场景。

周末，几位有影响力的人发布了他们所谓的“OpenAI 夏令营”的视频，该夏令营在纽约哈德逊河谷的豪华度假村野花农场举行。 周末房价通常超过每晚 2,000 美元。

根据与会者的帖子，行程包括用餐、有关 OpenAI 最新工具的课程以及户外活动，包括与养蜂人的会议。

创作者还收到了 OpenAI 品牌的商品，包括帆布袋和蜂蜜罐。

这种田园诗般的静修并没有吸引网上的每个人。

OpenAI 告诉《商业内幕》，这次务虚会是一次以教育为重点的活动，与最近推出的 ChatGPT Work 相关，也是其通过创作者推销其产品实际用途的更广泛努力的一部分。

一位发言人表示：“创作者是我们社区的重要组成部分，也是人们获取信息和了解我们产品的方式。”

OpenAI 的高端之旅也正值人工智能实验室试图扭转其公众形象之际。 这些公司一直在美国各地迅速建设数据中心，但由于对能源价格上涨、用水和潜在就业岗位流失的担忧而面临强烈抵制。

但本周末的田园内容很快在社交媒体上招致批评。 许多人质疑为什么一家与多个能源和水密集型数据中心相关的公司要在一个以自然为中心的度假村里吸引有影响力的人。

一位 Reddit 用户写道：“这是使用反乌托邦这个词的正确语境。”

在 X、Reddit、TikTok 和 Instagram 上，评论者指责 OpenAI 进行“绿色清洗”，而其他人则批评创作者在没有讨论该技术对环境影响的担忧的情况下推广人工智能。

记者泰勒·洛伦茨 (Taylor Lorenz) 在 X 上写道，参加该活动的创作者被“取消”。

有影响力的人因参加 OpenAI 品牌夏令营周末旅行而被取消，这非常有趣，因为我没有看到对参加人类活动（也与战争部合作）的有影响力的人有类似的批评。 我刚刚错过了吗？ pic.twitter.com/rWsJQf8CaG—泰勒·洛伦茨 (@TaylorLorenz) 2026 年 8 月 3 日

人工智能代理服务 Skye 的创建者初创公司 Signull Labs 将这次撤退与 OpenAI 竞争对手 Anthropic 的撤退进行了比较。 这家初创公司在其 X 账户上写道，Anthropic 一直保持低调，提供微妙的私人晚宴，而不是“引人注目的豪华度假胜地”。

“但是 OpenAI 使影响力操作完全可见，这可能就是让人们感到厌烦的地方，”它写道。

《商业内幕》联系的 OpenAI 静修会的创建者均未回应置评请求。 OpenAI 没有回答这次旅行的参加者是否获得报酬、OpenAI 是否承担他们的旅行或住宿费用，或者他们是否需要发帖。

一位发言人表示：“随着人工智能变得越来越普遍，我们欢迎健康的辩论，我们重视那些选择与我们互动、参加我们的活动、提出棘手问题并与其他人一起学习的创作者。” “我们将继续重视他们，就像我们重视传统媒体和其他营销合作伙伴一样。”

出席活动的创作者之一格蕾丝·麦卡里克 (Grace McCarrick) 发布了一段视频，表示她想在“与开发该产品的人一起在房间里”后制作一个系列。 她在一天的编码之前录制了这段视频，当时她正在准备洗澡。

“在 ChatGPT 品牌之旅中洗澡真是讽刺，”一位评论者说道。

此后，她发布了两​​个视频来回应负面评论。

“我的道德没有受到损害，”她在一段视频中说道。 “我对人工智能及其为我们人类提供的机会感到非常兴奋。 句号。”

OpenAI 并不是第一家了解到影响者出走会引发审查的公司。

2023 年，快时尚巨头 Shein 在派创作者乘飞机前往中国参观其设施后遭到了严厉批评。 观众指责这些有影响力的人帮助该公司粉饰对其劳工和环境实践的指控。 化妆品公司 Tarte 也多次因奢华的创作者之旅而遭到强烈反对。

阿迪蒂·巴拉德 (Aditi Bharade) 贡献了报道。
